entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'agent' to speak with a representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I have this helmet I bought. I think it was last month? I just need to send it back. The website is so overwhelming, I couldn't figure it out.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is it more of a preference issue?

Oh, I don't really know. The box is still unopened. I just... I saw the color online and it's not what I expected in person. I'm worried about safety, you know? I want a brighter color for visibility. The whole thing is just confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help sort this out. One moment while I pull up your order history and our policy.

Okay, I see the order here. You received the helmet 33 days ago. Let's see... yes, according to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely get that return started for you.
Oh, really? So it's okay? That's such a relief.

Yes, absolutely. And since I see here that you're one of our VIP members, I'm going to email you a pre-paid shipping label right now to make this as easy as possible. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Wow, that's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. That takes a lot off my mind.
You're very welcome. That email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
